Welcome to Pro-Fusion For Client setup, please visit this page - Client Setup Page When you first log in, there are a few NPCs you’ll want to visit before setting off on your adventure. Many of them offer valuable quality‑of‑life items and services that make the early game much easier. You’ll find these helpful NPCs in our main hub zones: The Nexus, Plane of Knowledge, and Brell’s Arena. You should also find an item in your bags called the Little Buddy Confidence Booster 5000. Consider it your lifelong companion — it provides a series of tiered buffs that grow stronger as you progress. The more tiers you complete, the more powerful your Little Buddy’s buffs become 1) Costco From this vendor I would suggest purchasing the following : Purification Stone (Radiant Cure clicky) Annulment Stone (Abolish Beneficial clicky) Heros Stone(Charm and Nexus Port clicky) Book of Knowledge (Portal to Plane of Knowledge) (Free) Psalm of Health (Complete Heal clickie) (Free) Shrinkinator (As it sounds) (Free) Fabled Journeyman's Boots (50% run speed) 2) Confucius Remember the old days of buying or searching for your starter spells or skills? Not anymore, find Confucius! Hail Confucius - Click “Skills” to train those Click “spells” to train spells up to level 70 - Side note - Once you progress further new spells will be able to be purchased from kill points or from mob drops. Just pay attention to the wiki for the tier that you are working on. 3) Mel Gibson Mel Gibson - will offer you your first task (1.0) which is completed in Crushbone. Each of the progression NPC's have level ranges under their name. Just keep getting the task and follow along. Eventually you will move on to Grendel, Darby, and Conan. 4) Mercenaries If you plan on going the solo route or not boxing a whole group, be sure to pick up a mercenary. They are obtainable in Plane of Knowledge You will need to pick up the Journeyman Rnk II Healer merc (tank mercs are somewhat buggy currently). You will be charged 18 Plat per 3 minutes of use as long as merc is up so make sure you are looting! :) Pro-Tip, Hail your mercenary and it will give you the option to Buff and equip weapons. Make sure you tell him to equip weapons x2 to make sure he equips one in both hands. Also Buffs will scale as you level/progress through tiers (Like having the BuffBot with you at all times. You cannot buff while merc/self are in combat. So make sure you inspect buffs before large pulls! 5) Patches Ohoolihan This is the local buff bot NPC, just be sure to hail him before you head out. 6) Stephen Strange How strange — I explained how to get your first task but never mentioned how to actually reach the place! Don’t worry, you won’t be sprinting through PoK looking for a stone to click or doing anything that ridiculous. Stephen Strange (teleporter) will send you on your way! Hail Stephen Strange Click “recommended zones” - This list consist of the progression path of the task. You may also pick from a multitude of zones NOT on the recommended list. Make sure to have Stephen Strange targeted - Just say the first letter of the zone and he will give you options. - If you know the zone short name he will go ahead and teleport you there You can also create your on DZ of a instance, as you may have seen while hailing Stephen Strange. You can do this by clicking the option “DZ” while interacting with Stephen or you can issue a command in game if you know the zone's shortname. Command to create a DZ createdz ZoneShortName - Example: #createdz nexus Once you create a DZ, you will get some text in your chat windows that will allow you to click “I'm Ready” or “Send Everyone!”. I'm Ready - Will only send you to the instance - Command that it uses is - #sendmeexpedition Send Everyone - This will send everyone that is in the DZ to the zone. (Only applies to those that are in the same zone as the person saying send everyone) - Command that is used is - #sendeveryoneexpedition You can make those # commands a hotkey for easy

Wanting to create a easy to jump in and understand custom setup that is still very loyal to traditional EQ and lets you level through 70 while re-living some of the exciting items and zones that you likely spent a ton of time in. Fun drops that should lead to high levels of HP, damage, etc. It's not meant to be difficult but also not supposed to be a cakewalk! You can solo your way to 70 and get well equipped but you will likely want to duo or find help to progress through some of the tiers. At 70 and beyond, you should experience memorable zones but with a bit more difficulty and challenge. Should be a great time and some good content and we continue to add more and more quests and progression every day as well as tune existing content to keep things fresh. ProFusion - An Everquest Story Level 71 max - At 71 you begin to come to content where you will want to group with friends and have a fun time! No maximum on boxes or players per IP although a box army shouldn't be required. Public, Private solo , Raid, Guild instances to do as you need capable of porting entire raid/guild/group to a instance in one command! Items that can be earned by all to Zone Pull and Full Re Zone pops. Items to level up with AA to advance and be stronger. Custom Reaper system to de-level and become stronger upon updrading items. Custom EXP sword that be increase in ranks with AA currently up to 500% bonus! Nexus, PoK hub zones with porter, buff bot, custom vendor, skills bot, spells bot, etc. Hail pet's/familiars to be given buffs and to equip them with normal/custom weapons. Increased experience overall and some recommended zones have significant increases. AA usage level decreased overall. AA bonus items randomly throughout world and Prestige quest with AA reward for replayability. Fair Credit system for all. Epic 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 through natural progression on the way to 70 then begin to earn epics up to 5.0 in custom but retaining the feel of everquest. Legacy quests to get sought after items through history. Custom clickies and augments for QoL and fun damage. MQ2 is fine, I'd prefer no warping but assuming you play nice it doesn't break content. Very active staff of great people who do work around the clock to ensure players are happy. Also correcting any issues reported and making changes via player demand. We value our players input and suggestions and are always taken into consideration. Discord community is very active if you have any questions or issues.

Preface While I will call out specific rules and they will evolve over time, the general principal of the server is to play nice, respect each other, and do the right thing. I don't want to ban anyone if possible and will usually give warnings or suspensions to let someone cool off. See a corpse you want to loot but you didn't kill? Ask the person that killed it if they are still around. Someone camping a boss spawn? Ask them to let you know when they are done. Play nice, have fun. If you ever have any questions or need any advice, we have a very active community on Discord . That said, here are the rules of the road: Don't Exploit - Bugs will be introduced at times, do not intentionally profit or spread the damage by an obviously broken mechanic. Don't Kill Steal - If someone is working towards a target don't jump in front of them or try to out DPS. Accidents happen but you know what this means. Play Nice, Don't Grief Others - This is a fine line and it's subjective, but if you are doing things to intentionally make someones experience crappy, you are breaking this rule. No AFK Playing - This server is intended to be played from a keyboard, preferably socially, with friends. It is not for you to kick off a macro then come back when you wake up to collect your loot. Box Away - You shouldn't require a box army to defeat content, but if you want to box and as long as you follow the rules, go crazy. Use Warp with Caution - I don't have a problem with Warp to go from point A to point B. If you are using it to circumvent a mechanic or leapfrog someone, it's going to be a problem. Zone Aggro - Don't use zone-wide aggro items in a public zone if anyone else is present. If you think a rule is missing or unclear, please let me know here and I will add clarity. Someone Breaking a Rule? - The best option would be to get a video of it in some form or another. Alternatively, you can PM me on Discord and I can take a look. More Details on Using Warp I've said it to folks in-game and I'll post it here also. I'm not a fan of warp and I don't use it when I'm playing. It takes enjoyment out of the game for me personally. That said, I know a lot of folks do enjoy using warp and at this point I'm totally ok with it being used in ways that don't violate the rules above. I've only had a couple reports of folks using it to leapfrog, bypass intended mechanic, etc. and each time it was an accident and it was talked out. If it gets to be where everyone is sitting AFK warp-macroing to clear zones 24x7 to amass rare items, I will either put in punitive warp/loot code or just take it off the 'acceptable' list. In other words, please play nice with it and don't misuse! Most of you know that warping, item clicks, etc. are logged in the server anyways. Macro's, Automations, Etc. The game is not meant to be a burden and I would encourage you use Macro's wherever possible. Need to loot all those corpses? Use a macro! Want to give commands to your boxes? Use EQBC! This is a 'you know it when you see it' category. If you can sit and watch Netflix while your character plays itself throughout a zone, you've gone too far. Again, if you are taking action, you should be at keyboard playing! Item Refunds While I want and hope that everyone enjoys the server and content, I also have a career, kids, wife, etc. that I have to tend to and I can't be online all the time. When I do get online, I very much prefer to spend time tweaking content, creating new things, or just playing a character and beating up npc's! With that in mind, I would advise that you know what you are doing before randomly handing items into NPC's. Most NPC's should have return-item code built in, but just in case, check the wiki or ask someone. I am not planning to offer refunds for everything that gets turned in to the wrong NPC on accident. If the server broke or a bug burned you, I will certainly work to make it right, but just awareness that you should ask if unsure about turn-ins! What Happens if

Find the eqhost.txt file and verify that it looks as below: [LoginServer] Host=login.eqemulator.net:5999 4. Inside the RoF2 folder, find the eqgame.exe file Right Click the file and hover over “Send to” and click “Desktop (create shortcut)" Find the shortcut on your desktop - Right click on it and then click Properties - Add **patchme** to the end of the target field Profusion Server Files This is the time that you would need to update a few files. x: How to obtain the Ring of the Rainmaker Obtaining the Ring of the Rainmaker is simple! Mr. Moneybags is located in the Plane of Knowledge. Talk to him about the "Special Ring". This ring grants a buff of up to 50x platinum buff and a chance at Moneybags, worth 4800 or 9400 platinum. To increase the rank of the ring, turn in the ring to Mr. Moneybags which decreases your AA count accordingly. Upgrade Costs Initial cost to purchase ring is 1000 AA Points Increasing as you upgrade the ranks and costs are as follows: Ranks 1 through 20: 1000 AA (20,000 total) Ranks 21 through 30: 1250 AA (12,500 total) Ranks 31 through 40: 1500 AA (15,000 total) Ranks 41 through 49: 1750 AA (15,750 total) Rank 50: 2000 AA (2,000 total) Total AA Cost from Rank 1 through Rank 50 = 65,250 AA Points Final turn in will award Bling Bling : Ring of the Rainmaker

Repository for some useful macros using the built-in feature. While not as robust as MQ2, there is still plenty of functionality. The Basics I'll assume that everyone is familiar with creating a macro. If not, there are several resources available online. I found this one to be pretty comprehensive: There are too many commands to list, so I've concentrated on some useful ones here. You can see a full list of commands in game with the /help command. You can add up to 5 lines of commands per macro. One command per line except that /pause and /timer can be added to the same line as another command. Combining /pause and /timer Commands /pause and /timer are the only commands that can be added to the same line as another command. They must be added first and followed by a comma. /pause 30, /cast 1 Useful Commands /Pause - Pause in between commands. 1 second == 10 units. /Timer - Set a visible reset timer for the macro. 1 second == 10 units /UseItem - Click an item in your inventory. /Cast - Cast a spell from a memorized slot. Examples Cuddly Bear of Mass Rage Start a 5 minute timer after clicking. You can click for free as many times as you want during this 5 minutes. Hello and welcome to ProFusion server! This server is fun and streamlined to keep you busy but not overwhelmed. Everything can be accomplished solo with effort and ability to focus on what is needed. That being said, as a newcomer to PorFusion there are a few things we want to point out to begin your journey through this awesome progression style server. Remember that most everything has been customized and tuned for solo play but boxing is allowed without any limits. First, being level 1, you will appear in the Nexus and want to see Costco (Newbie Vendor) to grab a few things that will help you on your journey. Simply right-click on him to begin browsing his wares. If you left-click on the Qty to filter out what he naturally sells you will see a few items that are free to purchase. You will want to buy a few bags first. The dark blue hand made backpacks are nice being 10 slots and 10% weight reduction. Next you will want to buy 1 of each of the following, Universal Assembly Crate (Used for combining items for progression and upgrades) Little Buddy Confidence Booster 5000 (Clickable item casting a Damage Shield, Regen, and a Heal focus) Purification Stone (Clickable item used to cure most illnesses & debuffs) Hero Stone (Newbie charm item with nice stats and 36% haste along with a clicky to gate back to the Nexus) Annulment Stone (Clickable item used to strip mobs of their buffs) After getting those items look at the other items he has as some are still useful but not truly needed to progress. Items like Weapons, Food, Clickable buffs like DMF and Shrink. Also nearby Costco are a few other NPCs. Harold, who gives server information and worth a look at. Confucius, who helps with training skills and learning spells as you level, and Gordon a Banker. Now that you are ready to begin your journey you will want to first talk to Mel Gibson. Mel gives you tasks to complete that range from level 1 up to level 50. Simply hail him and follow his script. The first task he has for you is to get your Epic 1.0! Yes, you can start your epic at level 1!!. Don't let this confuse you as you will later receive tasks to get your 1.5, 2.0 and 3.0 epics as you progress and level! As for now you simply follow his script to receive your first task and your first journey onto this awesome and wonderful server! Crushbone will be the first zone you will begin with. You will want to run up the stairs to the teleport platform and talk to Stephen Strange. He can port you anywhere but will list recommended zones for progression. Just hail him and follow his script. Once in Crushbone make sure to "crush" those orcs and get a few levels and gear to be able to fight the mobs needed to complete you task. Gear will drop in every progression zone. It's random drops for all classes so just kill orcs until you get most of your gear and be at least level 10 to 12 to start killing The Taskmaster, The Orc Trainer, and the mighty Emperor Crush! Remember to always check your tasks (Alt+Q) for the required creatures and items needed to complete your task. We really hope you enjoy your time on Profusion and if you ever need help please feel free to ask in /ooc as a lot of players will be more then happy to assist you.
